notes: Opportunities for the Explore hub and the Opportunities feed (spec 22 → Data). The two rows below are made-up examples that show every field; their todos stop the import, so replace them with real opportunities or delete them. Each row is in Stackd's own words, written from the official program page, which is its source_url. A post on Instagram or anywhere else is never the source and is never copied, quoted or embedded; the import refuses social media links. url is the page Open the official page opens, often the same as source_url. who_for lists what Stackd can't check (GPA, citizenship), shown as Check yourself. audience is community_college, admitted_transfer or any; major_slugs are Explore majors (data/raw/explore), empty for any major; systems is UC and/or CSU, empty for any; terms are transfer terms like fall-2027, empty for any. deadline is the last day to apply, or null for rolling. cost is free, paid (the student is paid, like a stipend) or fee (the student pays). Check each row on its source_url, fill in retrieved_at with the date you checked it, have a second person check it, then run: npm run import -- data/raw/opportunities/2026-27.json --dry-run
